children: The HR leader returns to TVS Supply Chain Solutions, bringing two decades of experience across talent, organisational development and employee engagement

TVS Supply Chain Solutions has appointed Subhashree Pradeep as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), bringing her back to the organisation with nearly 20 years of experience across HR leadership, talent management, organisational development and employee engagement.
Pradeep most recently served as Head – Human Resources for the Water and Effluent Treatment business at Larsen & Toubro, where she led HR initiatives for the business vertical.
Before joining L&T, she held leadership positions at Sodexo, including General Manager – HR and Head – Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) for India, as well as regional HR leadership roles.

Her earlier stint at TVS Supply Chain Solutions spanned more than seven years, during which she worked across HR strategy, talent development, succession planning and global HR initiatives. Her return brings prior organisational experience alongside a broader leadership background gained across engineering, infrastructure and services businesses.

In her new role, Pradeep will lead the company’s human resources function, supporting its talent priorities, organisational effectiveness and workforce development as the supply chain solutions business continues to evolve.
